scope: Founder/Internal VM QA through HARA Commander; no commercial installation

checks.name: read_only_discovery
checks.evidence: get_config, device.info, ping, file.info, win.ini read, directory list

checks.name: read_pagination_unicode
checks.evidence: QA file read at offsets 0 and 2 returned all three lines with ação, emoji and 東京

checks.name: write_cas
checks.evidence: rewrite with current SHA-256 succeeded; stale SHA-256 was DENIED with blocker FILE_PRECONDITION_FAILED and mutation_performed=false; readback kept revised content

checks.name: process_exit_and_timeout
checks.evidence: transport PASS carried exit_code 7 for a failing command; a timed-out command carried state TIMED_OUT, exit_code null, and no output; neither was retried

checks.name: managed_session
checks.evidence: start/interact/output preserved Unicode and next_offset; QA-only session was killed by its own ID; final process.sessions count=4, RUNNING=0

checks.name: directory_offset
checks.evidence: limit=2, offset=0 and offset=2 returned the same two Windows system entries, both with transport PASS

checks.name: one_shot_truncation_recovery
checks.evidence: eight output lines with max_lines=3 returned only lines 1-3, output_truncated=true, session_retained=false, and no run_id

checks.name: search_and_edit_parity
checks.evidence: Windows capability catalog omits search, edit_block, read_multiple_files, copy, move and delete; a read-only search probe returned blocker UNKNOWN_FUNCTION_ID

limits: Single Founder/Internal Windows VM and a live connector. Historical bundle and installed script differ by hash and size; this alone does not establish tampering or signature validity of installed bytes. No clean commercial install, concurrent CAS, reconnect/rollback, hosted DEV, or production promotion was tested. No QGA guest-exec, Agent update, alternate VM start, or cluster Agent change occurred.
